plan.notes: Source: official ASU Degree Search major map for 'Civic and Economic Thought and Leadership, BS' (program code LACETLBS), 2024-2025 catalog year: https://degrees.asu.edu/major-map/ASU00/LACETLBS/null/ALL/2024 . Transcription method: automated parse of every term row (courses, credit hours, minimum grades) from the official major map page on 2026-09-30, spot-checked against the rendered page. Term names use ASU's own 'Term N' numbering. General Studies designations (HUAD, SOBE, SCIT, AMIT, GCSI, CIVI, SUST) are modeled as choice:true student-choice slots; OR-options are choice slots naming the alternatives. Per-course prerequisites are NOT listed on the ASU major map, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty. Campus: Tempe. Major map track groups (Moral and Political Thought, American Political Thought, Economic Thought and Political Economy, Leadership and Statesmanship for the 21st Century, Related Area Electives) are elective choice lists transcribed as choice slots with the group's courses as options.
